task: Design a premium synthetic Coach Performance OS proof and reusable member-to-coach review contract.
surface: Public product story, member today view, coach review view, and one GSAP review scene
audience: Premium coaches, performance teams, members, and implementation partners
first_read: One place to understand the person, guide the program, and prove progress.
standards: GSAP core, timeline, ScrollTrigger, and performance skills

references.label: Agentic Life OS public/private boundary
references.reason: Defines the non-executable public contract and separately governed private runtime.

references.label: Health Intelligence System product boundary
references.reason: Prevents a second health-data silo and preserves evidence and clinical boundaries.

references.label: v0 Performance Constellation
references.reason: Private static-composition exploration. Version b_xBHA9DFEkQr was inspected and rejected because its primary proof panels render clipped and partially empty; no generated code is accepted as canonical.

keep: Editorial first read and quiet dark-mineral composition
Visible evidence, consent, and audit boundaries
avoid: Fake biometric scores and clinical authority theater
Generic glass-card grids and decorative bubbles
Motion-dependent meaning and squeezed mobile graphs
direction.signature: Five semantic liquid lenses resolve a structured check-in into one coach-reviewed, member-agreed action receipt.
system: Tier C exact product UI until real product capture becomes Tier A
Dark mineral base with warm ivory, restrained teal, and amber roles
One hero timeline and one earned review narrative
Static, coarse-pointer, mobile, and reduced-motion routes
No PII, clinical data, live network submission, or backend claims

asset_quality.why_premium: An exact, readable synthetic product mechanism is the correct proof asset; decorative media cannot demonstrate the governed review workflow.

artifacts.notes: Static, responsive, motion, product, and safety contracts reviewed in source.
Canonical React/Vite consumer is implemented and contract-tested; desktop, mobile, and reduced-motion export inspection awaits an admitted browser QA window.
Version b_xBHA9DFEkQr screenshot inspected at 1920x1080 and rejected: the right-side proof stack is clipped, under-populated, and does not meet the readable product-mechanism gate.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier C exact product interface chosen; decorative Tier D visuals are explicitly blocked.

checks.name: product-boundary
checks.evidence: Public graph and review plans exclude PII, raw health data, clinical interpretation, execution, and egress.

checks.name: implementation-contract
checks.evidence: The consumer imports the canonical coaching package, validates the synthetic graph, and renders member and coach surfaces from one five-lens review request.

checks.name: anti-slop
checks.evidence: The canonical verifier scores the experience 100/100 with bundled fonts, grain, semantic liquid glass, and interaction states.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: The final code-rendered consumer has not yet been inspected because browser-qa preflight is HOLD under system memory pressure.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Desktop, mobile, keyboard, coarse-pointer, reduced-motion, and console inspection await an admitted browser-qa window.

score.notes: The contract-backed product implementation and safety boundaries are specific; final browser craft, responsive behavior, and motion remain unverified. Iterate after export inspection.

known_risks: The v0 iteration includes unsafe generated defaults such as ignored TypeScript errors and globally unoptimized images; these must not be imported.
The public runtime cannot establish current authority, consent, or data isolation.
The visual implementation is present, but final browser evidence is not complete.
